purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for AC configuration, runtime active state, authenticated identity/assurance, policy version, reauthentication requirements and remote authorization traces.

topics.name: AccessCore Activation Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for AC configuration, runtime active state, authenticated identity/assurance, policy version, reauthentication requirements and remote authorization traces.

semantics.separation_rule: Configured enablement, runtime active state, authenticated identity, assurance and authorization decision are visibly distinct.
semantics.action_rule: reload ac, login, reauth, policy edit and config changes invoke separate authorized operations.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing AC state grants no policy-admin or governed-resource rights.
semantics.secret_rule: Credentials, tokens, session secrets and reauthentication secrets are never displayed.
semantics.failure_rule: Protected/error states are displayed explicitly and never represented as AC disabled/off.
semantics.trace_rule: Displayed allow/deny/reauth results retain exact identity/resource/policy refs.

invariants.rule: AccessCore activation, login, assurance and runtime protection are explicit lifecycle semantics; once active, AccessCore cannot be silently bypassed or disabled by an ungoverned runtime/config mutation.

hard_gates.condition: monitor conflates AC enabled with authenticated
policy error displayed as AC off
authorization result lacks exact policy/resource refs

prose.summary: Define a read-only Expose monitor for AC configuration, runtime active state, authenticated identity/assurance, policy version, reauthentication requirements and remote authorization traces.
